articles.title: John Steinbeck’s ‘East of Eden’ Returns to Top of Book Charts Following Netflix Adaptation’s Release
articles.summary: Fresh off the heels of the hit Netflix adaptation, created by Zoe Kazan and starring Florence Pugh, John Steinbeck’s “East of Eden” is at the top of Amazon’s Best Sellers List in the No. 1 spot. In addition, the audiobook of the novel is on the retail giant’s “Best of #BookTok” books list too.

First released in 1952, “East of Eden” is a multi-generational family saga that follows the painful and brutal lives of the Trasks and the Hamiltons during the post-Civil War era in the Salinas Valley in California. The story spans throughout the late 19th and early 20th centuries, as it culminates at the end of World War I.
And if you’re an Amazon Prime member, you can get “East of Eden” shipped to you home when it’s release within two days with Prime Delivery.

Created and co-written by Zoe Kazan (granddaughter of Elia Kazan, the director the 1955 film adaptation starring James Dean) the TV limited series “East of Eden” is now available to watch on Netflix. It stars Florence Pugh, Christopher Abbott, Mike Faist, Hoon Lee, Ciarán Hinds, Martha Plimpton and others. The series was first announced in June 2022 and dropped in its entirety on Thursday, Oct. 1.

articles.title: Marjoe Gortner, Preacher and Actor Who Was Subject of Oscar-Winning Doc and Appeared in ‘Earthquake,’ ‘Falcon Crest,’ Dies at 82
articles.summary: Marjoe Gortner, whose childhood as an evangelical preacher was the subject of the Oscar-winning documentary “Marjoe” and who went on to have a career as an actor, died Friday. He was 82. His wife Susan Magestro told Variety he died in Santa Fe, N.M.
body: Born in Long Beach, California, in an evangelical family, the name Marjoe is a combination of “Mary” and “Joseph.” His parents pushed him to become a child preacher, staging a photo op for the press when he performed a marriage ceremony at 4 years old. The family traveled around the country preaching and soliciting donations, and when Gortner was 16, his father absconded with what was reported to be $3 million in donations.
In his 20s, Gortner became disillusioned with the evangelical movement and became an aspiring actor in New York.

When he was approached by documentarians Howard Smith and Sarah Kernochan, he agreed to let them follow him around on his final revival tour in 1971, partially to help publicize his acting career. The resulting documentary, “Marjoe,” won the Oscar for best documentary. Roger Ebert saw it at the Cannes Film Festival and wrote “The real sleeper this year is ‘Marjoe. It generated the most electric response of anything at the festival.” It attracted considerable attention at the time, though it was later “lost” for many years until Kernochan was able to obtain rights to the film after tracking down the owner.

articles.title: DIRECTV MySports Genre Pack With ESPN Unlimited Plan and NFL RedZone Just $49 for First Month, Ahead of MLB Playoffs, NHL and NBA Seasons
articles.summary: DIRECTV is making a play for sports fans just as the fall calendar hits its busiest stretch, rolling out a discount on its sports-focused streaming pack that bundles ESPN Unlimited Plan, NFL RedZone from NFL Network and dozens of other live sports channels.
body: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Variety may receive an affiliate commission.

In addition to ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU and ESPNews, MySports includes NFL Network, FS1, FS2, CBS Sports Network, Big Ten Network, SEC Network, NBA TV, NHL Network, MLB Network, TNT, TBS and truTV. Local ABC, CBS, Fox and NBC affiliates are also, though availability varies by location.

NFL RedZone from NFL Network, of course, is designed for Sunday afternoons, jumping between games and showing scoring plays from across the league. It makes the add-on particularly useful for viewers who want to follow multiple teams without purchasing NFL Sunday Ticket. NFL Sunday Ticket itself is not included with DIRECTV and remains a separate subscription through YouTube and YouTube TV.

The MySports deal extends well beyond football, too, arriving just in time for a packed fall sports calendar: Baseball’s postseason began on Sept. 29 with the Wild Card Series on NBC and Peacock, followed by the Division Series on Oct. 3, with the American League rounds airing on TBS and truTV and the National League rounds on Fox and FS1 before the World Series begins Oct. 23 on Fox.

articles.title: British Museum announces changes to ease Bayeux Tapestry queues
articles.summary: Measures include extended opening hours, as well as an audio guide and additional seating for visitors.
body: The British Museum has announced changes to how visitors see the Bayeux Tapestry exhibition after concerns over long queues and overcrowding.
The measures include plans for longer opening hours, as well as an audio guide, additional seating and clearer signage.
A museum spokesperson said the public response to the 11th Century embroidery had been "extraordinary", but acknowledged that some visitors had waited longer than they would have wanted.
Some people reported waits of up to two hours, while hundreds of ticket holders were reportedly turned away due to backlogs when the museum closed early last week due to a private event.

articles.title: ‘It’s OK to love somebody when they’re not perfect’: how John Cena conquered Hollywood – and why he refuses to abandon Vince McMahon
articles.summary: By embracing the role of amiable lunk, the wrestler turned actor has become an unlikely, and very modern, leading man. But does his relationship with the WWE, and its controversial former owner, risk tarnishing his brand? I must admit, I was apprehensive about meeting John Cena.
body: John Cena is a company man. The word “loyalty” comes up often, and about everything from his friends back home to the wrestling to the US itself. Admirable, no doubt. But Cena’s loyalty has drawn him into some uncomfortable positions, and for 20 minutes our good-natured chat about reliability, discipline and what it means to owe everything to something bigger than yourself has set us on a collision course with one of the most disgraced figures in modern entertainment.

Cena was born in West Newbury, Massachusetts, in 1977, one of five boys in a household that watched every dollar. His grandma and grandpa lived in an adjoining house. “There was a lot of ‘How are we going to pay the bills, how are we going to keep the lights on?’” Cena says. He worshipped the movie action men of the era – Schwarzenegger, Stallone, Willis – but he also loved hip-hop, which in suburban Massachusetts made him a target for bullies. Bodybuilding was the answer, and it doubles as an origin story – the boy bullied for dressing like a white rapper, growing up to become an icon for the next generation of suburban youth.

articles.title: Glastonbury 2027 tickets sell out in 42 minutes
articles.summary: Thousands of people joined the queue in the hope of securing tickets to Worthy Farm.
body: Tickets for Glastonbury Festival 2027 sold out in 42 minutes, organisers have said.
Thousands of people joined the online queue at 09:00 BST in the hope of securing tickets to the festival at Worthy Farm in Somerset, which returns from 23 to 27 June after a fallow year.
Organisers confirmed last month that tickets for the weekend were at their highest price ever - £408, including a £5 booking fee per ticket - an increase of £29.50 from the last event in 2025.
Headliners have yet to be announced but organiser Emily Eavis previously said the team was "very excited" and things were "coming together really well".

articles.title: ‘In The Heart of the South’ Director Wants to Change the Narrative For Indigenous Filmmakers: “You’ve Been Telling Our Stories Forever”
articles.summary: Nyla Innuksuk's supernatural thriller, where themes of trauma and tragedy come painfully alive, is screening at the Vancouver Film Festival this week.
body: Nyla Innuksuk’s supernatural thriller In the Heart of the South is the latest Canadian indie aiming to reclaim indigenous storytelling and representation in movie theaters.

In the Heart of the South centers on Yura Ivalu, a young Inuk artist played by Anna Lambe (True Detective) who takes Toronto’s art world by storm. But the offer of a big movie deal has Ivalu stuck between two worlds as an indie Canadian producer, The Quiet Loud, encourages her to dredge up a childhood trauma to boost future box office.

And Ivalu’s artistic ambitions only spiral out of control when an estranged childhood friend, Sesi, played by Zorga Qaunaq, shows up in Toronto to crash her glamorous party scene and movie ambitions. Innuksuk underlines the moral dilemma she and other indigenous filmmakers face as Ivalu, beset by deep-seated fears, has to choose between telling stories prized by the Canadian film industry around trauma and tragedy, or going beyond colonial stereotypes to represent her Inuit community and legends with authenticity and truth.

articles.title: Chris Hemsworth Teamed Up With A Game Of Thrones Star For This Little-Seen Crime Thriller
articles.summary: Before he joined the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Chris Hemsworth teamed up with Sean Bean for a small crime thriller that you almost certainly haven't seen.
body: Chris Hemsworth has become one of Hollywood's most recognizable stars. That has a lot to do with him being part of the core Avengers team as Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, but he's been steadily acting for the better part of 20 years now. Before he picked up Mjolnir, though, he teamed up with a "Game of Thrones" star for a largely forgotten crime thriller.

The thriller in question is 2010's "Cash," aka "Ca$h." The "Game of Thrones" star in question is Sean Bean. He is surprisingly not the actor who has died the most on screen, but Bean is known for his deaths in movies and TV shows, very notably in "GoT," when his Ned Stark was memorably killed in Season 1. Just before his run as Ned Stark in Westeros, Bean partnered with Hemsworth at the beginning of the latter's movie career for this low-budget motion picture.

articles.title: 15 Scariest Horror Movies Of All Time, Ranked
articles.summary: The best horror movies ever made aren't necessarily the most terrifying, so here's a list of what we think are the scariest horror movies of all time.
body: Whether it's during Halloween season or just on those dark and stormy nights with friends, there's just something about horror movies that captivate us like no other genre. Modern and international horror movies especially leveled up their fear factor compared to their 20th century counterparts, really elevating the visceral terror. That said, there are still quite a few older scary movies that pack a horrifying punch all these decades later and keep us coming back for more. With those qualities in mind, we're taking a look at the most unsettling and scariest movies from the horror genre.

To clarify, this list consists of the most terrifying horror movies, not necessarily the best horror movies ever. These are the movies that still have us looking away from the screen despite knowing what's coming next or the ones that we hesitate to revisit alone at night. After the credits roll on some of these movies, we're still left sitting blankly on our couch trying to recover from the cinematic scares that these films provide.
Here are the 15 scariest horror movies of all time, ranked down to the most frightening of them all.

articles.title: Avengers: Endgame Passes Avatar To Reclaim All-Time Highest-Grossing Movie Title
articles.summary: Avengers: Endgame has officially regained the title of the highest-grossing movie of all time, unadjusted for inflation, stealing the crown back from Avatar.
body: It's official: Earth's Mightiest Heroes have taken back the box office crown from James Cameron. Thanks to "Avengers Endgame: Encore" ruling the box office as Marvel seeks to build hype for "Avengers: Doomsday," the massive superhero crossover has once again reclaimed the title as the highest-grossing movie of all time. Once again, "Avatar" now has to be content with second place... for now, at least.

Per Variety, the "Encore" re-release has brought the lifetime gross of "Avengers: Endgame" to $2.925 billion globally. That means it has overtaken the lifetime total of "Avatar," which has amassed $2,923,710,708 to date. Cameron's "Avatar" became the biggest movie of all-time twice: First in 2010 during its initial run in theaters when it made $2.74 billion worldwide, then again in 2022 thanks to a theatrical re-release. But now, it's the Marvel Cinematic Universe that stands tall over Pandora as the number one movie in history, unadjusted for inflation.
points: Avengers: Endgame has officially regained the title of the highest-grossing movie of all time, unadjusted for inflation, stealing the crown back from Avatar.
